title: Shuttle saturday stop trial
brief:
Write a public notice for riders of the free Saturday Loop shuttle. Starting May 2, the Depot stop moves for four Saturdays to the bench outside the market entrance at 18 Clay Street. Fictional historical figures from a spring pilot count riders boarding at that location and at the regular Depot stop on separate service days. Four market-stop counts were 21, 24, 27, and 28. Four Depot-stop counts were 12, 16, 14, and 18. Include a correct comparison of mean boardings per service day. Departures remain hourly from 9 a.m. to 1 p.m. Riders can leave comments with the driver.

Aim for 70 to 150 words. Return the complete original work directly in your answer. Do not sign or identify yourself. Do not use tools.

65e1fa52351b1443.text:
**Free Saturday Loop shuttle — temporary Depot stop move**

On May 2, 9, 16, and 23, board the free Saturday Loop shuttle at the bench outside the market entrance at **18 Clay Street**. The shuttle will use this stop in place of the regular Depot stop on all four Saturdays. Departures remain hourly from 9 a.m. to 1 p.m.

In the fictional spring pilot, the market stop averaged 25 boardings per service day across four days. The regular Depot stop averaged 15 across four separate days, so the market stop averaged 10 more boardings per service day.

You can leave comments about the temporary stop with the driver.

c39553a55b042bfa.text:
**Saturday Loop shuttle | Temporary Depot stop move**

Starting May 2, the free Saturday Loop shuttle will use the bench outside the market entrance at 18 Clay Street as its Depot stop for four Saturdays. Departures remain hourly from 9 a.m. through 1 p.m.

During the spring pilot, the market stop averaged 25 boardings per service day, compared with 15 at the regular Depot stop. Each average is based on four separate service days. The market stop averaged 10 more boardings per day.

Riders can leave comments with the driver.
